description: This file defines classes and functions for managing browser targets, contexts, downloads, and related events in a Firefox environment, specifically for integration with Playwright. It includes classes like TargetRegistry, PageTarget, BrowserContext, and DownloadInterceptor, and handles browser automation tasks such as page creation, navigation, permissions, cookies, and screencasting.

classes.name: DownloadInterceptor
classes.description: Handles download request interception, creation, completion, and cancellation in the browser environment.

classes.name: TargetRegistry
classes.description: Manages browser targets, contexts, and events, facilitating page creation, navigation, and resource management.

classes.name: PageTarget
classes.description: Represents a page or tab within the browser, managing its lifecycle, navigation, dialogs, and recording features.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context, managing permissions, cookies, proxies, and page settings.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a modal dialog in the browser, such as alert, prompt, or confirm.

methods.name: TargetRegistry.instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TargetRegistry.

methods.name: TargetRegistry.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TargetRegistry, sets up observers, and manages browser windows and tabs.

methods.name: TargetRegistry.cancelDownload
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download by UUID.

methods.name: TargetRegistry.newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page within a specified browser context.

methods.name: PageTarget.updateViewportSize
methods.description: Updates the viewport size of the page.

methods.name: PageTarget.setZoom
methods.description: Sets the zoom level for the page.

methods.name: PageTarget.dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and removes the page target.
